summary: recommend-resources meets the D3 shape, and its policy and resolved-chart keying hold. Blocking: apply aborts halfway when the operator edits a patch back to the file's current values (F1). The hunk-edit overrule that relies on --recount has no test (F2), and neither does the per-stage write path for non-prd stages (F3).

findings.summary: A patch edited back to the current values applies as a no-op; git commit then fails mid-loop, leaving earlier repos committed, later ones staged, and a re-run refused
V08 hunk edits are tested only for a same-line-count edit; removing --recount, which line-deleting overrules need, leaves the suite green
config/<stage>/values.yaml for non-prd stages (kubecoder-dev, keycloak-dev) is untested; hard-coding config/prd survives the suite
Local-app resolved-chart name is asserted only where chart name equals app name; keying on the app name survives
apply's invalid-YAML refusal and its reset rollback have no test
Out of scope (verbatim policy): requests are raised without regard to limits; the proof already puts prometheus-server's request equal to its limit
